bibl.title: Tautologies and Transpositions: Aristarchus' Less Known Critical Signs.
bibl.seg: Francesca Schironi, Tautologies and Transpositions: Aristarchus' Less Known Critical Signs.
bibl.note: The extant testimonia for antisigma and stigmai to indicate redundant and misplaced lines show that these sigla were seldom used, likely felt to be ambiguous and problematic. - Tautologies in Iliad 8. - Transpositions in Iliad 2. - Confusing sigla in Homeric manuscripts. - Conclusions.
